dedupe_keys.name: conab boletim da safra de graos brazilian grain crop surveys and forecasts

description: The Boletim da Safra de Grãos is the monthly survey of Brazil's grain harvest, giving area, yield and production estimates by crop and state together with the national supply and demand balance for grains such as soybeans, maize, rice, beans and wheat. Each crop season has twelve surveys (levantamentos); the twelfth survey of the 2025/26 season was published on 15 September 2026. It is produced by the Companhia Nacional de Abastecimento (CONAB), the Brazilian federal food supply company, which also publishes coffee and sugarcane crop surveys, a crop calendar and outlook reports. Coverage is national, broken down by region and state. Each survey comes as an XLSX data table of production and the supply and demand balance, a PDF bulletin and a presentation, free to download, and the site states a Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives 3.0 licence. Caveats: figures for the current season are forecasts revised every month, the pages are in Portuguese, and the no-derivatives licence limits redistribution of modified tables. For simulation it provides production forecasts and supply and demand balances for one of the largest grain exporters, used in models of food and freight flows, of storage and port capacity, and of how drought or floods change harvests. It is related to the Global Dataset of Historical Yields record in this catalogue, which gives gridded yields for major crops.
